يحدث هذا عادة عند تفعيل BattlEye، أو حظر الملف من مكافح الفيروسات، أو انهيار اللعبة (Crash).
Error.ModuleNotFound:
GTA V could not load the YimMenu DLL — it may be incomplete or missing a dependency.
Re-download it on the Download page. If it keeps failing, install the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64).
Error.DllMissing:
The menu DLL wasn't found on disk.
Your antivirus may have quarantined it — YimMenu is often flagged. Add an exclusion, then re-download it on the Download page.
Error.NotADll:
The selected file isn't a valid Windows DLL.
Pick the correct YimMenu DLL, or use YMU's built-in download to get the right one.
Error.BadArch:
GTA V needs a 64-bit YimMenu DLL, but the selected DLL isn't compatible.
Use the official DLL for your edition — both Legacy and Enhanced are 64-bit.
Error.ProcessGone:
GTA V closed before injection finished.
Start the game, wait for it to finish loading, then try again.
